messages.author: 1f723d378f24adbb
messages.subject: parallel chains in rstan
parts:
Hi,

Is there a recommended & convenient way of running parallel chains (eg
3) from rstan? I looked at the list archives and found some
suggestions, but I was wondering what the easiest and most idiomatic
solution is.

Best,

Tamas

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: parallel chains in rstan
parts:
If you are not using Windows, then the last few lines of

example(sflist2stanfit)

are the easiest and most idiomatic solution. If you are using Windows, then probably the easiest thing to do is create a socket cluster using the snow package and call stan() on each of the workers passing it the precompiled model.

Ben
